column3: The Hebrew says in this I trust; BSB says I will keep my trust.
The Hebrew leaves the object of inquiry in His temple unnamed; BSB supplies Him.
The Hebrew makes my head the subject of rising; BSB says it will be held high.
The Hebrew’s quoted command says My face; BSB says His face.
The Hebrew says for and a completed forsaking; BSB says though and uses a present description.
The Hebrew has one breathing violence in the singular after the plural witnesses.
The Hebrew begins unless I had believed, leaving the consequence unstated; BSB states certainty positively.
The Hebrew explicitly names strengthening the heart; BSB says be courageous.
